name: Riluzole
summary: Riluzole is a medication used to treat amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and other motor neuron diseases. Riluzole delays the onset of ventilator-dependence or tracheostomy in some people and may increase survival by two to three months. Riluzole is available in tablet and liquid form.

pharmacology.text: Riluzole preferentially blocks TTX-sensitive sodium channels, which are associated with damaged neurons. Riluzole has also been reported to directly inhibit the kainate and NMDA receptors. The drug has also been shown to postsynaptically potentiate GABAA receptors via an allosteric binding site. However, the action of riluzole on glutamate receptors has been controversial, as no binding of the drug to any known sites has been shown for them.

uses.text: Riluzole is a medication used to treat amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and other motor neuron diseases.

summaryZh: 利魯唑是賽諾菲推出的一種用來治療肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症的藥物。它可以延遲部分病人依靠醫用呼吸機或進行氣管切開術的時間，從而延長約兩至三個月的生命。
summaryZhHans: 利鲁唑是赛诺菲推出的一种用来治疗肌萎缩性脊髓侧索硬化症的药物。它可以延迟部分病人依靠医用呼吸机或进行气管切开术的时间，从而延长约两至三个月的生命。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include tiredness, nausea, dizziness and reduced lung function. It can raise liver enzymes, and rarely causes serious liver injury or a drop in white blood cells, so blood tests are used to monitor it.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括疲倦、噁心、頭暈和肺功能下降。它可能使肝臟酵素上升，少數情況下造成嚴重肝損傷或白血球減少，因此需要抽血監測。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括疲倦、恶心、头晕和肺功能下降。它可能使肝脏酵素上升，少数情况下造成严重肝损伤或白血球减少，因此需要抽血监测。

fact.en: Riluzole was the first drug approved for motor neurone disease, in the mid 1990s, and for many years it was the only one.
fact.zh: 利魯唑是 1990 年代中期第一個獲准用於運動神經元疾病的藥物，多年來也是唯一的一種。
fact.zhHans: 利鲁唑是 1990 年代中期第一个获准用于运动神经元疾病的药物，多年来也是唯一的一种。
